items.title: licenseal
items.summary: Catch incompatible dependency licenses before release
items.description: A free, open-source CLI that checks every dependency license, transitive ones included, against your project's license, in 10 ecosystems. It reads lockfiles and registry metadata, installs nothing, and gives CI a verdict, not a list.
items.titleZh: licenseal

items.descriptionZh: 一个免费、开源的 CLI，可在 10 个生态系统中检查每个依赖项的许可证（包括传递依赖），并将其与你的项目许可证比对。它读取 lockfile 和注册表元数据，不安装任何内容，并向 CI 给出一个结论，而不是一份清单。

items.title: Dedica

items.description: Dedica tests your website the way AI agents use it, then gives your team a fix for every place they fail. Dedica runs 125 checks (for free) to see if they can use your site, and gives you a fix for every issue to hand to your coding agent.
items.titleZh: Dedica：检查 AI 智能体能否使用你的网站
items.summaryZh: Dedica 用于检查 AI 智能体能否使用你的网站。
items.descriptionZh: Dedica 会以 AI 智能体使用网站的方式测试你的网站，然后为你团队提供每个失败之处的修复方案。Muse、Instinct、GrokBot 及其他智能体现已代表人们浏览、比较和注册。Dedica 运行 125 项检查（免费）来查看它们能否使用你的网站，并为你提供每个问题的修复方案，以便交给你的编码智能体。

items.title: OneDeploy
items.summary: Open-source apps on your own server, with no per-seat fees
items.description: Run open-source apps on a server that's only yours, without per-seat fees. Pick one of 105 apps and a region, see the exact price, and a few minutes later it runs on its own server with a web address, TLS certificate and nightly encrypted off-site backups. Add your own domain, update, resize or move region from the dashboard. You pay for the server by the hour, capped monthly. The price follows the server, not your headcount.
items.titleZh: OneDeploy
items.summaryZh: 在自己的服务器上运行开源应用，无需按席位付费。
items.descriptionZh: 在只属于你的服务器上运行开源应用，无需按席位付费。从 105 个应用中选择一个并选择区域，查看确切价格，几分钟后它就会在自己的服务器上运行，并带有网址、TLS 证书和每晚加密的异地备份。你可以添加自己的域名，在仪表板中更新、调整规格或迁移区域。服务器按小时计费，按月封顶。价格取决于服务器，而不是你的员工人数。

items.title: Open For sales
items.summary: Your next sales campaign is one prompt away
items.description: Open for Sales turns one prompt into a full sales campaign. Give Companion your products and a CSV of contacts. It checks every persona, scores fit, writes an editable sequence across calls, email and WhatsApp, then builds a live dashboard to track it. It's the outbound side of Open, the customer communications engine already running AI support across voice, chat, email and more. One engine now answers the customers you have and reaches the ones you want next.
items.titleZh: Open For sales：一句话生成完整销售活动
items.summaryZh: 你的下一场销售活动只差一个提示词。
items.descriptionZh: Open for Sales 将一句提示词转化为完整的销售活动。向 Companion 提供你的产品和联系人 CSV。它会检查每个用户画像、评估匹配度、撰写可编辑的跨电话、电子邮件和 WhatsApp 的序列，然后构建实时仪表盘进行跟踪。它是 Open 的外拓侧，Open 是已在语音、聊天、电子邮件等渠道运行 AI 客服的客户沟通引擎。一个引擎现在既能服务你现有客户，也能触达你接下来想争取的客户。

items.title: Yardlet
items.summary: The Mac app for the coding agents you already use
items.description: Yardlet is a free, open-source Mac app for the coding agents you already use. It starts Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and others with their own CLI and sign-in, and gives them one sidebar, composer and set of approval cards. Sessions stay in each agent's own store, so a task started in Yardlet also opens in the Codex app. It writes nothing into the agents' configuration, so you can stop using it any time. Diffs, a pull request tab, connectors and a browser the agents drive come with it.
items.titleZh: Yardlet：面向现有编码智能体的 Mac 应用
items.summaryZh: 为你在用的编码智能体提供的 Mac 应用。
items.descriptionZh: Yardlet 是一款免费、开源的 Mac 应用，面向你已经在使用的编码智能体。它会以各自的 CLI 和登录方式启动 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等智能体，并为它们提供一个侧边栏、一个输入区和一组审批卡片。会话保留在各智能体自己的存储中，因此在 Yardlet 中启动的任务也能在 Codex 应用中打开。它不会向智能体的配置写入任何内容，所以你可以随时停止使用它。它自带差异视图、拉取请求标签页、连接器，以及由智能体驱动的浏览器。

items.description: Stop describing UI bugs to your AI. Click any element on your localhost site, say what's wrong, and Claude Code, Codex, Gemini or OpenCode edits the right file. Watch it work live, then approve the diff on the page. Nothing is written until you do.
items.titleZh: PulseDev：点击本地网站上的 UI bug，AI 智能体即可修复
items.summaryZh: 在本地网站点击任意元素并说明问题，Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 或 OpenCode 就会修改正确的文件；你可以实时观看，并在页面上批准 diff 后才会写入。
items.descriptionZh: 不必再向 AI 描述 UI bug。在本地网站点击任意元素，说明哪里不对，Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 或 OpenCode 就会编辑正确的文件。你可以实时观看它工作，然后在页面上批准 diff。在你批准之前，不会写入任何内容。

items.title: Revix AI
items.summary: AI code review that learns your repo's own rules
items.description: Revix AI scans your repo, generates its own pattern and architecture rules, and reviews every pull request against them. It keeps learning as the repo changes. Each comment names its rule and is labeled by intent and severity. Free for public repos.
items.titleZh: Revix AI
items.summaryZh: 能学习你代码仓库自身规则的 AI 代码审查工具。
items.descriptionZh: Revix AI 扫描你的代码仓库，生成自己的模式与架构规则，并依据这些规则审查每个拉取请求。它会随仓库变化持续学习。每条评论都会注明其所依据的规则，并按意图和严重程度标注。公共仓库免费。

items.title: fswitcher
items.summary: fswitcher replaces Command-Tab on your Mac
items.description: cmd+tab replacement for macOS built for multiple displays. It looks and feels like the original, with proper handling of app switching, window switching, and multiple displays. One-time purchase, and no subscriptions.
items.titleZh: fswitcher
items.summaryZh: fswitcher 取代你 Mac 上的 Command-Tab。
items.descriptionZh: 面向多显示器的 macOS cmd+tab 替代工具。它的外观和操作感受与原版相似，能正确处理应用切换、窗口切换和多显示器场景。一次性购买，无订阅。

items.title: Nuvio 5.0
items.summary: Hand your financial admin to your AI agent
items.description: Nuvio automates financial management with AI-powered tools for startups. Track income, expenses, and cash flow effortlessly, get real-time insights, and predict trends. Save time, reduce errors, and make smarter decisions with automated financial tracking.
items.titleZh: Nuvio 5.0
items.summaryZh: 把你的财务管理工作交给 AI 代理。
items.descriptionZh: Nuvio 通过面向初创公司的 AI 工具实现财务管理自动化。轻松跟踪收入、支出和现金流，获取实时洞察并预测趋势。借助自动化财务跟踪节省时间、减少错误并做出更明智的决策。

items.title: throxy (yc p25)
items.summary: Cold calls in your prospect's language. Pipeline delivered.
items.description: throxy is Y Combinator's first AI native sales agency, booking qualified sales meetings for B2B companies selling into industries where generic outreach fails: manufacturing, logistics, construction. We build lists using proprietary tech, then our sales reps call your buyers. New this month: calls routed to an SDR who speaks the lead's language, so a plant manager in Lyon hears French + a buyer in Munich hears German. You pay for meetings you accept that actually happen. [All SDRs are humans]
items.titleZh: throxy（YC P25）
items.summaryZh: throxy 用潜在客户的语言进行冷呼叫，为 B2B 公司预约合格销售会议；本月新增将电话转接给会说线索语言的 SDR。
items.descriptionZh: throxy 是 Y Combinator 首家 AI 原生销售代理，为向制造业、物流、建筑等通用外联失效行业销售的 B2B 公司预约合格销售会议。我们使用专有技术构建名单，然后由销售代表致电你的买家。本月新增：电话会路由给会说线索语言的 SDR，因此里昂的工厂经理听到法语，慕尼黑的买家听到德语。你只为接受且实际发生的会议付费。[所有 SDR 都是真人]

items.title: OpenRadView
items.summary: Free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-rays
items.description: OpenRadView opens the DICOM and NIfTI files from your scan CD or zip on your own computer: linked axial, coronal and sagittal views, experimental 3D and measurements. Optional MCP access for your own AI agent. It is a personal research project for education and has not been clinically validated. Ask a qualified clinician to interpret your scans; do not use the app for decisions about care.
items.titleZh: OpenRadView：开源医学影像查看器
items.summaryZh: OpenRadView 是免费开源查看器，可在自己的电脑上查看 CT、MRI 和 X 光影像。
items.descriptionZh: OpenRadView 可在你自己的电脑上打开来自扫描光盘或 zip 的 DICOM 和 NIfTI 文件：联动的轴位、冠状位和矢状位视图，实验性 3D 和测量功能。可选择为自己的 AI 代理提供 MCP 访问。这是一个用于教育的个人研究项目，尚未经过临床验证。请让合格的临床医生解读你的扫描影像；不要使用该应用做出医疗照护决策。

items.title: Hob
items.summary: Open-source, on device alternative to Claude and ChatGPT
items.description: Hob is a free, open-source AI app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works with your files the way ChatGPT and Claude do, except the AI runs on your own computer. It picks the best open model your computer can run and sets it up for you. Hob can read and edit files in folders you choose, turn spreadsheets into charts, fill in PDFs, look at photos and search the web. Your chats and files stay on your computer, and it works offline.
items.titleZh: Hob：开源设备端 AI 应用
items.summaryZh: Hob 是开源、设备端的 Claude 和 ChatGPT 替代品，可处理文件并让聊天与文件留在本地电脑。
items.descriptionZh: Hob 是一款免费、开源的 AI 应用，适用于 Mac、Windows 和 Linux，可像 ChatGPT 和 Claude 那样处理你的文件，区别在于 AI 在你的电脑上运行。它会选择你的电脑能运行的最佳开源模型并为你完成设置。Hob 可以读取和编辑你所选文件夹中的文件，把电子表格转换成图表，填写 PDF，查看照片并搜索网页。你的聊天记录和文件保留在你的电脑上，并且可离线使用。

items.title: Agent Handshake by Fini
items.summary: Agent-to-agent customer support that holds its answer
items.description: Fini is the self-improving AI agent for customer support. It resolves 90% of tickets at 99% accuracy across voice, chat, and email, built for fintech, banking, and other regulated industries where a hallucination isn't an option. Most support AI needs constant re-tuning. Fini detects its own knowledge gaps, learns from real resolutions, and gets sharper on its own. Live in 14 days. Fully autonomous in 30. Works on your existing helpdesk, no migration.
items.titleZh: Fini 的 Agent Handshake
items.summaryZh: 会坚持自身答案的智能体间客户支持。
items.descriptionZh: Fini 是面向客户支持的自我改进 AI 智能体。它在语音、聊天和电子邮件渠道中以 99% 的准确率解决 90% 的工单，专为金融科技、银行和其他受监管行业打造，在这些行业中幻觉不是选项。大多数支持 AI 需要不断重新调优。Fini 能检测自身知识缺口，从真实解决案例中学习，并自行变得更敏锐。14 天上线，30 天完全自主。可在你现有的帮助台上运行，无需迁移。

items.title: iPad mini 8
items.summary: OLED, A20 Pro and IP67 in Apple's smallest iPad
items.titleZh: iPad mini 8
items.summaryZh: Apple 最小尺寸 iPad 配备 OLED、A20 Pro 与 IP67。

items.title: Dotverse
items.summary: Your Dot now with a crew
items.description: A Mac app for your existing Dot in ChatGPT. Create a crew with different roles and personalities.
items.titleZh: Dotverse
items.summaryZh: 你的 Dot 现在有了团队。
items.descriptionZh: 一款 Mac 应用，用于你在 ChatGPT 中现有的 Dot。创建具有不同角色和个性的团队。

items.title: Arcade Controller Pro
items.summary: A fight controller with no stick and its own screen
items.description: 8Bitdo controllers are designed to be as versatile as possible with each of your modern devices. Easily pair your controller as an X-input or D-input device via bluetooth. You can even use it as a wired USB controller with the included USB cable.
items.titleZh: Arcade Controller Pro
items.summaryZh: 一款没有摇杆、自带屏幕的格斗控制器。
items.descriptionZh: 8Bitdo 控制器旨在尽可能适配你的各种现代设备。可通过蓝牙轻松将控制器配对为 X-input 或 D-input 设备。你甚至可以使用随附的 USB 线缆将其作为有线 USB 控制器使用。

items.title: Off Grid AI
items.summary: Private AI on your phone and computer.
items.titleZh: Off Grid AI
items.summaryZh: 在你的手机和电脑上运行的私密 AI。

items.title: Zest
items.summary: Hold ⌥Space, flick, and an AI agent does the dev chore
items.description: Hold ⌥ Space in any project and a Liquid Glass ring opens at your cursor. Flick at a slice and let go: Claude Code, Codex or your terminal takes the task, in its own git worktree if you want. When it's served, view the diff, merge it or yeet it. Runs locally.
items.titleZh: Zest
items.summaryZh: 按住 ⌥Space 轻扫，AI 代理替你完成开发杂务。
items.descriptionZh: 在任意项目中按住 ⌥ Space，光标处会打开一个 Liquid Glass 圆环。朝某个扇区轻扫并松开：Claude Code、Codex 或你的终端会接手任务；如你愿意，它会在自己的 git worktree 中运行。任务完成后，查看差异，合并或弃置。本地运行。
